hero_section.description: Ensure your APIs are secure, highly performant, and functioning flawlessly. We rigorously test your backend architecture to prevent data leaks, eliminate bottlenecks, and guarantee seamless integrations.

introduction_section.heading: ما هو
content: APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) are the invisible bridges connecting your frontend interface to your backend databases and external third-party services. If your API fails, is slow, or has a vulnerability, your entire application suffers.

Unlike traditional UI testing, API testing bypasses the graphical interface to interact directly with your software's core logic. At Devisgon, we validate your REST, GraphQL, and SOAP endpoints for functionality, reliability, load capacity, and security. We ensure your system communicates flawlessly and securely under any condition.
introduction_section.highlight_quote: “Bugs found at the API layer are 10x cheaper to fix than those found in the UI.”

case_study_section.headline: Eliminated payment gateway timeouts and increased conversions by 15%

questions.question: Why do I need API testing if I am already doing UI testing?
questions.answer: UI testing is slow, brittle, and only verifies what the user sees. API testing verifies the actual business logic and data. Because APIs can be tested without a graphical interface, you can find and fix critical bugs much earlier in the development lifecycle.

questions.question: Do you test both REST and GraphQL APIs?
questions.answer: Yes. We have extensive experience testing traditional RESTful architectures, SOAP web services, and modern GraphQL endpoints where queries and mutations require specific data structure validations.

questions.question: Can you test APIs that require complex authentication?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We routinely write test scripts that handle complex, multi-step authentication flows, including OAuth 2.0, JWT (JSON Web Tokens), API Keys, and session cookies.

questions.question: Will these tests run automatically?
questions.answer: Yes! The ultimate goal of our API testing service is automation. We package our test suites using tools like Postman (Newman) or REST Assured so they can be triggered automatically by your CI/CD pipeline every time your developers push new code.
